propositions: Findings raised on early patchsets and not re-emitted on later ones fail to reach consumers because the code-review artifact is keyed by (change_id, revision) per patchset

Standing findings must be classified into one of three states—still-present (region unchanged or unresolvable), addressed (region changed), or withdrawn (already carried once)—to determine eligibility for carry-forward injection

Carried findings are injected via a new optional standing_findings workflow input into merge_findings post-Pass-1, never raising a posture beyond the origin_decision clamped by the prior surfaced bucket

The reader must expose the prior payload's revision and the bucket (blocking/advisory) each finding came from, so the injection site can resolve carry-forward state and origin posture without the workflow seeing it
Carry-forward is one-shot: an already-carried item withdraws itself and is never re-raised, terminating the chain after one patchset regardless of further edits
